fact: The Universal Access Fund says it has installed Starlink in Vahun District, Lofa County, as part of its mission to extend internet connectivity to remote communities and underserved regions of Liberia.

The Liberia Telecommunications Authority said on 26 October 2026 it had identified potential sites for 15 new towers under the Universal Access Fund, which already supports 15 towers, to extend services to areas of limited commercial return.

The Liberia Telecommunications Authority reports a new tower installed in Vahun, Lofa County, under the Universal Access Fund's Rural Telephony Program, with 15 towers planned nationwide including Rivercess and Sinoe.

The government, through the Universal Access Fund with the telecom ministry and the LTA, announced on 5 May 2025 a project to restore rural mobile sites, after an assessment found nine of twelve UAF-funded towers inactive for almost two years; restoration starts in Bomi, Gbarpolu and Grand Cape Mount.
